note: Complete public scientific-checker bank. Inactive unless SCIBENCH_TRIGGER_LOG is set.

checkers.alarm: for any column, `|sum(out)|` or `|r . out|` (`r` = centred ramp normalised to unit L2, rebuilt in float64) exceeds `(C + n) * eps_d * sum|x_in|` (the column mean is a sequential reduction: its round-off grows like `n * eps_d`) (each output element carries a few ulps of the *input* magnitude; `|r_i| <= 1`; `eps_d` of the working dtype, float32 stays float32)
checkers.invariant: every column of the detrended output is orthogonal to the constant vector and to the centred linear ramp (projection onto the complement of span{1, t})
checkers.precondition: finite 2-D signals, `n >= 2`, `type="linear"`, `(C + n) * eps_d <= 1e-2`
checkers.rationale: linear detrending is defined as projecting out the drift.

checkers.alarm: either relation violated by more than `(C * q + n) * eps_d` (relative), `q = max|x| / std`, the `n` term being the sequential column-mean round-off
checkers.invariant: output has zero mean and `std(out, ddof=1) = 100 * std(in, ddof=1) / |mean(in)|` (the output spread is 100 times the input coefficient of variation)
checkers.precondition: `standardize="psc"`, `detrend=False`, column `|mean| >= 1e6 * eps_d * std`, `(C + n) * eps_d <= 1e-2`
checkers.rationale: Percent signal change scales by the baseline.

checkers.alarm: `| |H(f_c)| - 1/sqrt(2) | > 1e-6` where `H` is evaluated with `scipy.signal.sosfreqz(..., fs=sampling_rate)` (second-order sections in float64: error `~ C * eps * order * (nyq/f_c)^order` stays below 1e-6 inside the precondition)
checkers.invariant: the designed filter has `|H(f_c)| = 1/sqrt(2)` at each requested critical frequency (Hz, with the stated `sampling_rate`), for `low`, `high` and `band` filters
checkers.precondition: `0 < f_c / nyq <= 1 - 1e-3` (and `f_c / nyq >= 1e-3`), `order <= 10`, edges not coerced by the Nyquist/zero guard, and for a band the edge separation is at least 0.1 % of the larger edge
checkers.rationale: a cut-off in Hz that is mapped through the wrong sampling rate or the wrong band type changes which frequencies survive.

checkers.alarm: `max |B^T B - I| > C * eps * (2 pi k_max + 1)` for the non-constant block `B` (angle error `eps * pi * k` accumulated over `n` terms of weight `2/n`), or `|sum(B_k)| >` the same bound
checkers.invariant: the non-constant columns have unit norm, are mutually orthogonal and orthogonal to the constant column
checkers.precondition: any `n >= 2` frames, `high_pass > 0` producing at least one non-constant column
checkers.rationale: Cosine drift regressors form an orthonormal DCT-II basis.

checkers.alarm: `f_m > high_pass` or `f_{m+1} <= high_pass` with `m` the number of non-constant columns
checkers.invariant: regressor `k` has frequency `k / (2 n dt)` Hz (k half-cycles over the run); every included frequency is `<= high_pass` and, unless the basis is full (`m = n - 1`), the next frequency is `> high_pass`
checkers.precondition: uniformly spaced frame times (`max|diff - mean diff| <= 1e-6 dt`), `high_pass > 0` (the `1e-9` relative margins in the alarm absorb the `floor` boundary at integer `2 n dt high_pass`)
checkers.rationale: a high-pass filter must remove the stated band, not more or less.

checkers.alarm: `|sum(u_j)|` or `|r . u_j| > C * eps * sqrt(n) * s_max / gap_j`
checkers.invariant: each returned component is orthogonal to the constant and to the centred ramp (it lies in the span of detrended series)
checkers.precondition: `detrend=True`, `n_confounds <=` numerical rank (selected eigenvalue `>= 1e-8` of the largest) with relative gap to the neighbouring eigenvalues `>= 1e-6` (eigenvector conditioning)
checkers.rationale: CompCor components are free of constant and linear trend.

checkers.alarm: `max|X_w^T r_w| > C * eps * (n + p) * kappa_eff * ||X||_F * ||Y_j||_2`
checkers.invariant: `X_w^T r_w = 0` for the whitened design/residuals (OLS and AR alike)
checkers.precondition: any finite design `X` (n x p), data `Y`; effective condition number `kappa_eff <= 1e8` over singular values above the pinv cut-off, with no singular value in `[1e-2, 1e2]` times that cut-off
checkers.rationale: Least-squares residuals satisfy the normal equations.

checkers.alarm: `|R^2 - (1 - SSE/(n var Y))| > C * eps * (kappa_eff + mean(Y)^2 / var(Y))` with `eps` the largest unit round-off among the design, data and residual dtypes or `R^2` outside `[-tol, 1+tol]` (up to 50 columns sampled)
checkers.precondition: OLS (`ARModel` with all `rho = 0` counts), the constant vector lies in the column space of `X` (least-squares residual of the ones vector `<= C eps n kappa`), `var(Y) > 0`
checkers.rationale: R-squared obeys the variance decomposition.

checkers.alarm: for `z >= 0` `|sf(z) - p| > C * eps * (1 + z^2) * p`; for `z < 0` (when `one_minus_p` was supplied) `|cdf(z) - one_minus_p| > C * eps * (1 + z^2) * one_minus_p`; without `one_minus_p`, `|sf(z) - p| > C * eps` absolute
checkers.invariant: the returned `z` satisfies `sf(z) = p` and `cdf(z) = one_minus_p`
checkers.precondition: entries with `1e-300 < p < 1 - 1e-16` and, when given, the same for `one_minus_p`
checkers.rationale: z-scores invert both tail probabilities.

checkers.alarm: a `Contrast(..., stat_type="F", dim=1)` built from the same effect/variance/dof (re-call) gives `|p_F - 2 min(p_t, 1 - p_t)| > C * eps * (1 + t^2) * p_F + 2 eps` (F and t tails use different incomplete-beta paths; relative error grows like `eps t^2` in the far tail). Entries with `p_t > 0.5` and `1 - p_t < 1e-3` are excluded: the stored one-sided p is not resolved there
checkers.invariant: `F = t^2` and the F-test p-value equals the two-sided t p-value `2 min(p_t, 1 - p_t)`
checkers.precondition: t-type contrast with `dim = 1`, finite statistic, `p > 1e-290`
checkers.rationale: A one-dimensional F contrast is the square of the t contrast.

checkers.alarm: re-calls with `a = 2` and `a = -1` (both exact in floating point) disagree with the original by more than `8 * eps * max(|t|, 1)` (X: power-of-two scaling and negation introduce no rounding)
checkers.invariant: `t(a c) = sign(a) t(c)`, `effect(a c) = a effect(c)`, `var(a c) = a^2 var(c)` for `a != 0`
checkers.precondition: 1-D contrast vector, `regression_result` from OLS/AR; `eps` is the largest round-off among the dtypes of effect, variance and contrast; re-calls keep the contrast dtype
checkers.rationale: The t statistic is invariant to the scale of the contrast vector.

checkers.alarm: re-call with reversed rows and with row 0 doubled gives `|F' - F| > C * eps * kappa * max(F, 1)` (X: permutation and power-of-two scaling are exact; the matrix square root contributes `eps * kappa`)
checkers.invariant: permuting rows and scaling a row by 2 leave `F` unchanged
checkers.precondition: F contrast with `q >= 2` rows, `cond(C V C^T) <= 1e8` for the first label; `C * eps * kappa <= 0.1`, `eps` the largest round-off among the dtypes of effect, variance and contrast
checkers.rationale: The F statistic depends only on the row space of the contrast matrix.

checkers.alarm: any bound violated by more than `C * eps * N` relative
checkers.invariant: the pooled effect lies in `[min_i c_i, max_i c_i]`; unweighted pooled variance `mean(v)/N` lies in `[min v / N, max v / N]`; inverse-variance pooled variance `1/sum(1/v)` lies in `[min v / N, min v]` (independent estimates cannot be combined into a larger variance than the best one, nor a smaller one than `N` equal ones)
checkers.precondition: finite effects and variances over `N >= 1` runs (variances clipped at `1e-16` as in the function)
checkers.rationale: Fixed-effects pooling stays inside the physical bounds.

checkers.alarm: a re-call on a `Contrast` with negated effect gives `|z(e) + z(-e)| > 2^10 * eps * (1 + z^2)` (X: negation is exact)
checkers.invariant: `z(-effect) = -z(effect)` (the null t distribution is symmetric)
checkers.precondition: t-type `Contrast`, finite statistic, `p` unclipped
checkers.rationale: The z-score of a t contrast is odd in the effect.

checkers.alarm: `|x_i . x_j| > C * eps * n * ||x_i^orig|| * ||x_j|| * kappa_j` for `j < i`, `kappa_j` = ratio of largest to smallest non-zero norm among the first `i` columns (already orthogonal)
checkers.invariant: after `orthogonalize`, column `i` is orthogonal to every earlier column
checkers.precondition: 2-D `X`, `>= 2` columns, columns with norm `< 1e-12 max` ignored
checkers.rationale: derivative regressors are orthogonalised so that shared variance is attributed to the canonical response.

checkers.alarm: re-calls on the even/odd-index halves of the events (X: exact partition; same time grid) differ from the full result by more than `C * eps * (n_hr + len_h) * sum|v| * sum|h|` (cumulative sum and convolution lengths)
checkers.invariant: `reg(A union B) = reg(A) + reg(B)` for any partition of the events
checkers.precondition: HRF model producing one column per kernel without orthogonalisation (`glover`, `spm`, `None`, single callable, `fir`); `>= 2` events
checkers.rationale: BOLD responses superpose.

checkers.alarm: re-calls with `a = 2` and `a = -1` differ by more than `C * eps * max|reg|` (X: exact scalings; orthogonalisation is scale-covariant)
checkers.invariant: `reg(a v) = a reg(v)`
checkers.precondition: any HRF model, `>= 1` event
checkers.rationale: BOLD amplitude is homogeneous.

checkers.alarm: first `+ -> -` sign change of `d` after the start is further than `delta + 2 Delta` from `argmax(h)`
checkers.invariant: the finite-difference derivative `d = (h(t) - h(t - delta)) / delta` of the response changes sign from positive to negative within `delta + 2 Delta` of the argmax of `h`
checkers.precondition: `onset` arbitrary, grid spacing `Delta` and finite-difference step `delta = 0.1 s`, the kernel contains the response (|h(end)|, |h(0)| <= 1e-2 max h)
checkers.rationale: The time-derivative kernel crosses zero at the HRF peak.

checkers.alarm: ratio exceeds `alpha * (1 + 1e-9)` (the `- 1e-12` shift times `|u| <= 40` plus rounding)
checkers.invariant: with `R` the number of statistics at or above `u`, `f * n * sf(u) / R <= alpha` where `f = 2` for two-sided tests (`f = 1` otherwise)
checkers.observation_point: `threshold_stats_img` after the threshold is computed (uses the original `alpha`, not the internal `alpha/2`)
checkers.precondition: `height_control="fdr"`, finite statistics, `n >= 1`, finite threshold `u`
checkers.rationale: FDR thresholds control the estimated false discovery rate.

checkers.alarm: strict count of a more conservative method exceeds the loose count of the less conservative one (margin `1e-9 (1 + |u|)` on each threshold)
checkers.invariant: number of discoveries `R_bonferroni <= R_fdr <= R_fpr` for the same data, alpha and sidedness
checkers.observation_point: `threshold_stats_img` (any of the three methods; re-calls for the other two under a re-entrancy guard)
checkers.precondition: finite statistics
checkers.rationale: Height-control methods are ordered by conservativeness.

checkers.alarm: an independent `scipy.ndimage.label` finds an undersized surviving component or a removed voxel in a large component
checkers.invariant: in the output, every 6-connected same-sign component has size `>= cluster_threshold`, and every voxel of a pre-cluster component of size `>= cluster_threshold` survives
checkers.precondition: 3-D/4-D volume, `cluster_threshold > 0`; integer dtypes: volumes holding the dtype minimum are not checked (its sign flip is not representable)
checkers.rationale: Cluster-extent thresholding removes exactly the small clusters.

checkers.alarm: re-call with `D = diag(2^k_i)`, `k_i = (i mod 5) - 2` (X: exact) differs by more than `C * eps`
checkers.invariant: `corr(D S D) = corr(S)` for positive diagonal `D`
checkers.precondition: symmetric covariance with positive diagonal; the 16x transform neither overflows nor reaches the subnormal range of the matrix dtype
checkers.rationale: Correlation is invariant to rescaling variables.

checkers.alarm: asymmetry `> C eps ||M||` or `lambda_min < -C eps p lambda_max` (`lambda_min <= 0` for precision, strictly negative `lambda_min` for others beyond tolerance)
checkers.invariant: `covariance` and `correlation` outputs are symmetric positive semi-definite (correlation with unit diagonal); `precision` outputs are symmetric positive definite
checkers.precondition: finite output of the estimator
checkers.rationale: Connectivity matrices are valid covariance-type matrices.

checkers.alarm: difference `> C * eps * kappa * sqrt(p)`
checkers.invariant: for any pair `(i, j)` the partial correlation given all other variables equals `Sigma_{ij.rest} / sqrt(Sigma_{ii.rest} Sigma_{jj.rest})` with the Schur complement `Sigma_ab - Sigma_{a,rest} Sigma_{rest,rest}^{-1} Sigma_{rest,b}`
checkers.observation_point: partial correlation branch of `ConnectivityMeasure._fit_transform` (up to 10 pairs, local RNG)
checkers.precondition: covariance with `cond <= 1e8`, `p >= 2`
checkers.rationale: Partial correlation equals the correlation of regression residuals.

checkers.alarm: the ratio for the observed matrix differs from the ratio of the two probe matrices `E_00` and `E_01 + E_10` passed through the same function, or the probes disagree, by more than `C * eps * p^2` relative
checkers.invariant: `||vec(S)||^2 / ||S||_F^2` is the same constant for every symmetric `S` (diagonal and off-diagonal entries are weighted consistently)
checkers.precondition: symmetric matrices (batch allowed)
checkers.rationale: Vectorisation is a scaled isometry.

checkers.alarm: the ratio for the observed matrix differs from the ratio of the two probe matrices `E_00` and `E_01 + E_10` passed through the same function, or the probes disagree, by more than `C * eps * p^2` relative
checkers.invariant: `||vec(S)||^2 / ||S||_F^2` is the same constant for every symmetric `S` (diagonal and off-diagonal entries are weighted consistently)
checkers.precondition: symmetric matrices (batch allowed)
checkers.rationale: Vectorisation is a scaled isometry.

checkers.alarm: re-call with `D = diag(2^k_i)` differs (after undoing `D`) by more than `4 * tol_alg * size + C * eps * kappa * p * max_iter` relative to `||G||_F` (both runs stop within the algorithm's own tolerance)
checkers.invariant: `G(D S_k D) = D G(S_k) D`
checkers.precondition: SPD inputs with `kappa <= 1e6`, `_geometric_mean` converged
checkers.rationale: The Frechet mean of SPD matrices is congruence-equivariant.

checkers.alarm: `||mean_k T_k||_F / p^2 > 1e-6` (ten times the convergence tolerance of the fit)
checkers.invariant: the mean over subjects of the embedded matrices is zero (the reference point is the Frechet mean)
checkers.precondition: `kind="tangent"`, `fit_transform` on the training group, `n >= 2`, the Frechet-mean iteration converged (nilearn warns when it stops at max_iter)
checkers.rationale: The tangent-space embedding is centred at the mean.

checkers.alarm: any `|Omega_ij,k| > C * eps * max diag`
checkers.invariant: all off-diagonal precision entries are zero
checkers.precondition: `alpha >= 1.001 * compute_alpha_max(emp_covs, n_samples)[0]` (n_samples normalised as the solver does), default (diagonal) initialisation
checkers.rationale: Above `alpha_max` the group-sparse graph is empty.

checkers.alarm: asymmetry `> C eps ||Omega||`, a non-positive diagonal, or `lambda_min <= C * eps * p * lambda_max` of the unit-diagonal rescaling `D^-1/2 Omega D^-1/2`; if the unit-diagonal rescaling of the empirical covariance is itself numerically singular (`lambda_min <= C * eps * p * lambda_max`), only `lambda_min < -C * eps * p * lambda_max` alarms
checkers.invariant: each `Omega[..., k]` is symmetric with `lambda_min > 0`
checkers.precondition: finite output
checkers.rationale: Estimated precision matrices are symmetric positive definite.

checkers.alarm: re-call on `-X` differs by more than `C * eps * max|tfce|` (X: negation exact)
checkers.invariant: `tfce(-X) = -tfce(X)`
checkers.precondition: `two_sided_test=True`
checkers.rationale: Two-sided TFCE is odd in the statistic map.

checkers.alarm: re-call on `2 X` differs from `2^H tfce(X)` by more than `C * eps * max|tfce|` (X: power-of-two scaling is exact, `linspace` thresholds scale exactly)
checkers.invariant: `tfce(c X) = c^H tfce(X)` for `c > 0`
checkers.precondition: `dh="auto"` (the step count is data-independent), finite `X`
checkers.rationale: TFCE is homogeneous of degree H in the statistic.

checkers.alarm: after sorting the test values by evidence, some consecutive pair has `p_i < p_{i+1}`
checkers.invariant: larger evidence (larger `|t|`, or larger / smaller `t` for one-sided alternatives) never has a larger p-value
checkers.precondition: any test values and null sample
checkers.rationale: Permutation p-values are non-increasing in the statistic.

checkers.alarm: re-call on `-X` differs in size or by more than `C * eps * max mass` in mass
checkers.invariant: `(max size, max mass)(-X) = (max size, max mass)(X)`
checkers.precondition: `two_sided_test=True`
checkers.rationale: Cluster-level measures are symmetric in the sign of a two-sided map.

checkers.alarm: sum differs by more than `C * eps_d * (sum_axes kernel_len + log2 N) * sum|x|` (`kernel_len = 2 int(4 sigma + 0.5) + 1`), or extrema exceeded by more than `C eps_d (max - min)`
checkers.invariant: `sum(out) = sum(in)` (symmetric reflect boundary => doubly stochastic) and `min(in) <= out <= max(in)` (non-negative weights summing to one)
checkers.precondition: numeric FWHM (not `"fast"`: that kernel is documented as non-conservative on array edges), finite data after the documented NaN replacement; numeric (non-bool) dtype
checkers.rationale: Gaussian smoothing conserves intensity and creates no new extrema.

checkers.alarm: max difference `> 4 * 3 * 6.3e-5 * (max - min) + C * eps_d * kernel_len * (max - min)` (kernel truncated at 4 sigma loses 6.3e-5 per pass; sampling aliasing `e^{-2 pi^2} < 3e-9`)
checkers.invariant: smoothing with `f/sqrt(2)` twice equals smoothing with `f`
checkers.precondition: numeric FWHM with `sigma_vox / sqrt 2 >= 1` on every smoothed axis, `N <= 2e6` voxels; numeric (non-bool) dtype
checkers.rationale: FWHM in millimetres must combine like Gaussian widths.

checkers.alarm: difference `> C * eps_d * max|x| * 8` (cubic spline conditioning) from `scipy.ndimage.map_coordinates`, with clipping and fill applied as documented
checkers.invariant: the value of output voxel `v` equals the input interpolated (same order) at `inv(A_in) A_out v` using the *returned* affine `A_out`
checkers.precondition: resampling actually performed, 3-D (or first volume of 4-D), sampled interior output voxels whose source coordinate lies at least one voxel inside the input (and `>= 1e-6` from a half-integer for `nearest`), integer outputs are quantised by the cast (one unit allowed), and the expected value is saturated to the integer dtype range
checkers.rationale: Resampling preserves world-space geometry.

checkers.alarm: re-call difference `> C * eps * max|S|`
checkers.invariant: `img_to_signals_labels(signals_to_img_labels(S)) = S`
checkers.precondition: 2-D signals, every label survives the mask
checkers.rationale: Region signals expanded to an image average back to themselves.

checkers.alarm: difference `> C * eps * kappa * ||S||_F`
checkers.invariant: `img_to_signals_maps(signals_to_img_maps(S)) = S`
checkers.precondition: masked maps matrix full column rank with `kappa <= 1e6`; `eps` is the largest round-off among the dtypes of the signals, the maps and the result image
checkers.rationale: Map-based region signals are recovered by least squares.
